mkp-cs:exchange@1.about: Two parties exchanging messages, such as a handshake, played one message at a time: two lanes with dashed lifelines, one row per message with its time, the current one lit and the ones to come faint; an event on one side is a dot, a lost message stops half way.

inputs.name: a
inputs.about: the party on the left

inputs.name: b
inputs.about: the party on the right

inputs.name: messages
inputs.about: the messages in order: send goes from a to b, reply from b to a, and an event happens on one side (left is a); note is said in the bar while it is current; time is the left column's text; lost never arrives

inputs.name: title
inputs.about: the header's title

inputs.name: unit
inputs.about: the time's unit, said after it in the bar (ms, s)

values.name: msgs

value.expr: map(messages, x => {from: if(x.dir == reply or (x.dir == event and x.side == right), "b", "a"), to: if(x.dir == event, "", if(x.dir == send, "b", "a")), label: x.text, reply: false, lost: x.lost, time: x.time, note: x.note})

comment: each message as a sequence's: from a lane to a lane, or on one

value.expr: {from: "", to: "", label: "", reply: false, lost: false, time: "", note: ""}

values.name: tw
comment: the time column: every time padded to one width (mono), so the lanes line up under the header

values.name: rows

value.expr: map(range(0, m - 1), k => {id: "m" + k, k: k, mm: msgs[k], a: lane(msgs[k].from), b: if(msgs[k].to == "" or msgs[k].to == msgs[k].from, lane(msgs[k].from), lane(msgs[k].to))})

comment: one row per message, in half-lanes: lane c's centre is boundary 2c+1 of 2na half-lanes; a row's
line runs from boundary p to boundary q, its label centred between them, and its ends are anchors
at the end of the cell before p and the start of the cell after q

values.name: p
values.body: if(local(r), 2 r.a, if(lost(r), min(2 r.a + 1, r.a + r.b + 1), 2 min(r.a, r.b) + 1))

values.name: q
values.body: if(local(r), 2 r.a + 2, if(lost(r), max(2 r.a + 1, r.a + r.b + 1), 2 max(r.a, r.b) + 1))
